annotations.title: Replace a Zotero note with Markdown

description: Replace the whole content of an existing Zotero note with new Markdown. The note keeps its key, parent item, tags and collections; only its text changes, and the old text is gone from Zotero (Zotero keeps no history of a note). The result returns the previous HTML as `previousNote` so it can be put back. Markdown: headings, paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code` and fenced code blocks, [links](https://...), > blockquotes, tables, horizontal rules, and $inline$ or $$display$$ math, all stored as the note editor's own HTML. Raw HTML is shown as text, not interpreted. Cite a library item with its key in brackets: [@ABCD2345], [@ABCD2345, p. 12], [see @ABCD2345; @WXYZ6789, pp. 3-5]. Each becomes a real Zotero citation (clickable in Zotero, live when the note is added to a Word document), and a key that names nothing refuses the write. Pass `version` (from zotero_get_item) to write only if nobody changed the note since you read it; without it the current text is replaced whatever it is. To add to a note instead, use zotero_append_to_note. Writes go to the running Zotero desktop app (Zotero 10+) for every library it holds, otherwise to the cloud Web API.

cite.description: Turn [@ITEMKEY] references into Zotero citations (default true). false leaves them as plain text.

library_id.description: Numeric id of the library to address, e.g. 5234875 for a group (zotero_groups lists the ids you can reach). Omit to use the configured default library; an id given without library_type is read as a group id.

library_type.description: Which library to address: "user" (a personal library) or "group" (a shared group library). Omit to use the library this server is configured for. "group" on its own is refused: pass library_id with it.

markdown.description: The note's new content, in Markdown. Everything the note held before is replaced.

note_key.description: Key of the note to replace.

title.description: A heading placed at the top of the note, which Zotero then shows as its title.

version.description: The note version you read. When given, a note that changed since is refused instead of overwritten.

name: zotero_replace_note

citations.description: How many [@KEY] groups became Zotero citations.

newVersion.description: The note's version after the write.

previousNote.description: The note's HTML before this write, to restore it with zotero_update_item ({"note": ...}) if needed.

retried.description: True when a version conflict made it re-read the note before replacing it.

target.description: Where the write went: "local" (Zotero desktop local API), "desktop" (connector protocol) or "cloud" (Zotero Web API).

title: Replace a Zotero note with Markdown
